meta.name: Dragon Ball Z Wrath of the Dragon
meta.description: The Z Warriors discover an unopenable music box and are told to open it with the Dragon Balls. The contents turn out to be a warrior named Tapion who had sealed himself inside along with a monster called Hildegarn. Goku must now perfect a new technique to defeat the evil monster.
meta.slogan: If he doesn't do it, who will?
